title: ICC asked to admit 4 more witnesses’ testimony on PNP killings

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — International Criminal Court (ICC) prosecutors in the crimes against humanity case against former President Rodrigo Duterte have filed new applications seeking to admit the prerecorded testimonies of additional witnesses. The testimonies detail the “pattern of crimes” allegedly committed by the Philippine National Police (PNP) during the Duterte administration’s war on drugs, which the prosecution said would help expedite the proceedings. In a 12-page request, the prosecution asked ICC Trial Chamber III to grant its application, saying the testimonies of witnesses “P-1136,” “P-1345,” “P-1391” and “P-1404” were “relevant, reliable and probative” to the case.
